turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Ray. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh good, another recorded call. Wonderful.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My transfer has been pending for six days. But sure, take your time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check the transfer status.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fantastic. Truly a world class experience.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see it held for review. I'm releasing it now — funds land within the hour.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wow, so it took one phone call. Amazing that nobody did that for six days.

labels.notes: Every positive word is sarcastic. Lexical sentiment scores this positive; the label is negative.
